name: nvidia-nim-on-spcs
displayName: NVIDIA NIM on Snowpark Container Services
description: Deploy NVIDIA NIM inference microservices on SPCS with no local Docker. Mirrors NIM images from nvcr.io into a Snowflake image repository inside the account (digest-preserving), then stands up GPU services with readiness probes, scoped egress, and PAT-authenticated endpoints. Config-driven NIM catalog, ships with genmol:2.0 and llama-3.1-8b-instruct validated.
